title: Sustainable closed-loop supply chain network planning with CCUS: A multi-objective robust optimization framework under two carbon policies
summary: Paper in the International Journal of Production Economics by Song Xu, Yuting Xie, Wenting Yang and Lu Liu. As its title states, it proposes a multi-objective robust optimisation framework for sustainable closed-loop supply chain network planning with CCUS under two carbon policies.
why_it_matters: Shows robust optimisation methods for supply-chain network planning that integrate CCUS under alternative carbon policy regimes, applicable to policy-scenario analysis.
authors: Song Xu, Yuting Xie, Wenting Yang, Lu Liu
approved_by: Published automatically (before the review step existed)
